start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:infinity on my bakery order page: request is to keep making the page load faster and easier to order from, scope is the page at https://bakery.example.com/order, constraints are no paid tools, authorized actions are editing the page and running its checks."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: its five steps hand back one evidence-backed answer each, kept on the run record.
instructions: 1. Write the request (the outcome to keep improving), the scope (what the AI may look at and change), constraints (what it must not do) and authorized_actions (the changes it may make); all four are required.
2. Say "Run workflow:infinity" with those four values; the AI starts it through tool:start-a-recipe-run and answers the steps in order: baseline, bottleneck, improve, continue.

3. At baseline, give the measured numbers with where each came from; at bottleneck, name the one constraint worth most; at improve, change one mechanism and test it for real; at continue, say what the next pass should measure.
4. Read what each step handed back: every completed requirement cites evidence ids kept in the same step. A requirement that could not be met stays open with its gap, never marked completed.
5. Run it again after the change to compare against the new baseline.

worked_examples.title: Baseline of a bakery order page
worked_examples.ask: Run workflow:infinity on my bakery order page.

input.request: Keep making the order page load faster and easier to order from.
input.scope: The page at https://bakery.example.com/order and its checkout form

worked_examples.given: Read from the row of workflow:infinity in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: the baseline step asks for the outcome, its observable baseline with provenance, and the capability review. The AI measured the page: it loads in 3.4 seconds on a phone and ordering takes 7 taps.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"summary":"Order page loads in 3.4 s on a phone and an order takes 7 taps; no measure was claimed as zero.","evidence":[{"id":"e1","source":"a phone load test of https://bakery.example.com/order","observed":"Fully loaded in 3.4 seconds on a mid-range phone"},{"id":"e2","source":"walking the order form by hand","observed":"Seven taps from the menu to the order confirmation"}],"requirements":{"baseline":{"state":"completed","what_happened":"Named the outcome (a fast, easy order), measured load time and taps, and kept elapsed time as its own measure.","evidence_refs":["e1","e2"]},"capability-review-baseline":{"state":"completed","what_happened":"Searched the Marketplace for page-speed and form tools; REA, 21st.dev and Mobbin reviewed and none changed the baseline.","evidence_refs":["e1"]}}}
